title: Queue
description: From an operator interface (Core checks it and passes it on unchanged) or Core: the Asset's whole task list, in order, as task_ids only. Each Task's body travels once in its own control.command or control.settings with task_id. The list replaces the Asset's list, but only once the Asset holds the body of every Task in it; until then it keeps running its current list and names the missing bodies in its queue report, and Core resends them. queue_version is the version the list was built on; the Asset ignores a list built on any other version. A Task that leaves the list without starting is reported cancelled. The Asset answers with its queue report, reply_from and reply_to naming this message.
